fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.article_body since the Yoast ld+json @graph has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, pmnewsnigeria.com/feed/) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (not_found, not_article, http_<code>, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the Yoast ld+json Article node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description, from <meta name="description"> (falls back to the ld+json WebPage node's description).

quickSummary.title: Quick summary
quickSummary.description: This site's own lead-in summary box ("Quick Read"), from div.quick_summary_box -- one short paragraph written by the desk to precede the full article.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from direct-child

tags of div.article_body. Often begins with the real reporter's byline as its own line ("By ") -- kept as-is, genuine article content.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name from the ld+json Article node's author field -- this is the WordPress publishing account (often a desk editor), which may differ from the real reporter named inside articleBody.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher/site name ("P.M. News"), read from the ld+json WebSite node's name field -- there is no Organization node or og:site_name meta tag on this site.

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section/category tags from the ld+json Article node (e.g. ["US"]).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword tags from the ld+json Article node.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL from the ld+json Article node's thumbnailUrl field.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of <category> values from the RSS item -- real section/tag values on this feed.

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item guid, in the WordPress ?p=<id> query-string format (not the same as link).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
